tools.name: create_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Generate a professional invoice PDF from structured JSON (parties, line items, tax, discount). Returns a download URL valid for 24 hours plus computed totals. No account needed for up to 10 documents/day; pass api_key or an Authorization header for plan quotas.

tools.name: create_receipt_pdf
tools.description: Generate a payment receipt PDF from structured JSON. Same schema as invoices (use `number` for the receipt number). Returns a 24-hour download URL and computed totals.

tools.name: create_einvoice_xml
tools.description: Generate an EN 16931 e-invoice as UN/CEFACT Cross-Industry Invoice (CII) XML — the format behind France's Factur-X and Germany's XRechnung mandates. Same JSON shape as create_invoice_pdf plus a few extra fields: from/to countryCode (required), from.vatId (required when taxRate > 0), optional payment

tools.name: parse_einvoice
tools.description: Parse EN 16931 e-invoice XML — UN/CEFACT CII (Factur-X, ZUGFeRD, XRechnung) or UBL Invoice/CreditNote (Peppol BIS) — into normalized invoice JSON: parties, line items, totals, VAT ids, payment details. Pass the XML document as a string.

tools.name: get_document_schema
tools.description: Returns the JSON shape accepted by create_invoice_pdf / create_receipt_pdf / create_einvoice_xml, a complete example payload, and current plan limits. Call this first if you are unsure how to structure a document.

tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description: Issue a free Slipstack API key (50 documents/month) for an email address, returned directly in the response — no signup flow, no email verification step. Idempotent: the same email always gets the same key back. Use the key as api_key on other tools or as an Authorization: Bearer header. Paid plans

tools.name: get_account_usage
tools.description: Returns the current month's document usage, quota, and plan for a Slipstack API key. Requires api_key (or an Authorization: Bearer header).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_invoice_pdf" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_api_key · Private data: create_invoice_pdf, parse_einvoice, get_document_schema, get_api_key, get_account_usage · Public sink: get_api_key · Destructive: create_einvoice_xml.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_api_key · Private data: create_invoice_pdf, parse_einvoice, get_document_schema, get_api_key, get_account_usage · Public sink: get_api_key · Destructive: create_einvoice_xml

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
